annotations.title: Check on a brief sent to Nikita

description: Returns where a brief sent with send_brief stands: with Nikita, replied, or a fixed quote sent, and any free call booked. Give the brief number (like A-12) and the email it was sent with, exactly as in send_brief's receipt. It shows only the status and dates, never the reply itself, which goes to that email. It changes nothing.

brief.description: The brief number from send_brief's receipt, e.g. "A-12".

email.description: The email address the brief was sent with.
